firstPlayerRule: Roll a die to determine the starting player; the highest result wins.
clarifications: The starting player gets 1 worker, the next player clockwise 2, the third 3 and the fourth 4.

The starting player places a piece on space 1 of the bridge (turn order track) and takes the white die. Later turn order follows the bridge, and whoever leads there becomes the next round’s starting player.

internalEvidence: Ravensburger US product page for The Castles of Burgundy (item 26925) links this manual. Downloaded and text-extracted all 16 PDF pages. Page 3: roll a die to determine the starting player (highest result wins); workers 1–4 are distributed clockwise; the starting player takes space 1 on the bridge and the white die. Pages 4–5: turn order follows the bridge, and moving forward on it can make you the next round’s starting player.
